note: English lines that teach Peppino's moves, rewritten for what these characters really do. The game's own line is used for every key not listed, and for other languages. Peppino in a line becomes the player's character.

rows.text: Press [J] to jump! You curl into a ball that breaks blocks and defeats enemies!
You can break marble and metal blocks underneath you with a slam! Press [D] and [J] while in the air!
The ball destroys metal blocks too, so jump into them or slam down on them!
Some blocks may be hidden, keep an eye out for them! Roll or spindash into them to destroy them!
Hold [D] and press [J] to charge a spindash! Tap [J] to rev it up, then let go of [D] to blast off! It can destroy marble blocks!
Get up to speed and run into a wall to start wall running!
Press [J] while wall running to jump off the wall!
Press [M] or hold [D] while moving to roll! Rolling down a slope builds speed fast. Try it out!
Jump while you're moving to carry your speed through the air!
At speed, you can also simply run up a slope next to a wall to start wall running!
Roll into a small gap to go through it and destroy the blocks inside!
Under a low ceiling the ball keeps moving where you hold, so you can't get stuck!
Press [D] and [J] in the air to drop straight down!
Speed is everything here! The longer you run, the faster you go, and the longer you take to stop!
To turn around at speed, press the opposite direction and skid!
Your speed carries through the air, so keep moving before you fall down a hole!
Hold [U] and press [J] to perform the Super Jump!
A Super Jump breaks everything above you on the way up! Give it a try!
Another trick: Spindash into a gap to go through it faster!
No need to grab anything: hit it as a ball and it's gone!
The ball works from any side, so jump up into things above you too!
Press [J] again in the air for your own move: Sonic's drop dash (hold it), Tails's flight, or Knuckles's glide (hold it, then climb the wall you hit)!
Did you know a spindash goes through enemy after enemy? It's the quickest way to keep your combo going.
An obscure technique: Press [D] and [J] in the air at any time to slam straight down. Only useful if you want to save time!
